newsitem.title: USA: Apple says initial MessagePad sales brisk.
newsitem.headline: Apple says initial MessagePad sales brisk.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc. said Sunday that initial sales of its newest mobile computer, the MessagePad 2000, have been brisk since the product was launched a month ago.

"The sales we have achieved in our first 30 days and customer response validate our claim that the MessagePad 2000 is a compelling business machine," Sandy Bennett, vice president of the Newton Systems Group said.
The MessagePad 2000 is a member of the line of handheld Newton computers. Some of its features include e-mail, fax and Internet access, and it weighs only 1.4 pounds.
